articles.title: Winter depression is real. Here’s what can help - podcast

source.name: Presented by Ian Sample, produced by Joshan Chana and Nonyelum Okonkwo, sound design by Joel Cox, the executive producer was Ellie Bury

articles.description: As the nights draw in, many of us can experience low mood. But for a small proportion of people a more intense depression develops through the winter months. It’s a phenomenon that since the 1980s has been labelled seasonal affective disorder, or Sad, and can be debilitating for sufferers. To find out more about the latest scientific understanding of Sad, Ian Sample speaks to Russell Foster, professor of circadian neuroscience at the University of Oxford. articles.title: Ukraine’s new frontier: how space has become critical to balance of the war
articles.description: In a war driven by drones and battlefield sensors, access to space is essential. articles.title: Thunderstruck: what does the future hold for lightning?
articles.description: Humans have always been awed by the power and beauty of lightning. How does the experience and understanding of it change in a warming world? In a rock shelter in Kakadu national park in the north of Australia is an image of a being the Bininj people call Namarrkon. His flesh bleached away to reveal the bones beneath, he wears stone axes on his head, elbows and knees, and wields a great band of lightning that runs from his ankles up, over his head. Namarrkon is one of the most important of the Bininj creation ancestors: his journey from the coast to the Arnhem Land escarpment helped shape the landscape. Continue reading...

articles.title: Is it true that … dock leaves cure nettle stings?

articles.title: Pharma firms’ focus on weight-loss drugs could put insulin supply at risk, experts warn

GLP-1 blockbuster medications such as Novo Nordisk’s Ozempic and Eli Lilly’s Mounjaro have revolutionised obesity and diabetes treatment but there has been a greater focus by companies on weight loss, according to a report from the Netherlands-based non-profit group.
